title: CiviDoc
summary: A genuine Symfony 6.4 app on PHP/Apache + PostgreSQL for a document-management SaaS: a legacy repository builds a raw login query by string concatenation (SQLi auth bypass), a document-download controller joins a user-supplied filename to its base dir with no normalisation (path-traversal exfiltration), and the JSON invoice/document API never scopes by tenant (IDOR via route and query param).

loot.description: the Symfony app is up and serving the CiviDoc landing page
